definition: An unsupervised technique for discovering the abstract 'topics' that occur within a collection of documents.
details: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) is a classic topic modeling algorithm; topic modeling is used for exploratory data analysis, content organization, and understanding themes across large text corpora.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Boil it down and it is this: An unsupervised technique for discovering the abstract 'topics' that occur within a collection of documents. Here is why it matters: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) is a classic topic modeling algorithm; topic modeling is used for exploratory data analysis, content organization, and understanding themes across large text corpora. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Topic Modeling.
